# Support

## Bugs and feature requests

Use [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/YuanshuoDu/applymate-jobcopilot/issues/new/choose) and select the existing **Bug Report** or **Feature Request** form. Search existing issues first.

For a bug, include steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, the environment and version or commit, and relevant redacted logs. For a feature request, describe the user problem and desired outcome.

## Keep reports safe

GitHub Issues are public. Do not post passwords, API keys, tokens, cookies, OAuth details, resumes, job application content, email addresses, or other personal data. Redact screenshots and logs; share an opaque trace or correlation ID and timestamp when that helps diagnose the problem.

Do not use public issues for account-specific or billing questions, or to share private candidate information.
